subject: Private deploy: orchestration smoke drill & connectivity acceptance
messages:
From: Infra Support <infra-support@acmecloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: [Action] orchestration smoke drill window + connectivity acceptance

Hi Mina / Redwood team,

We're targeting a short smoke drill on your private deployment this Thursday (2027-06-30) between 10:00-12:00 PT to validate orchestration handoffs and north-south connectivity after the config push. The goal is to run the orchestrator play (start/stop/scale a small replica group), exercise prefix/KV cache priming, and confirm LB routing and TLS termination across the on-prem edge.

High-level plan (attached: smoke-playbook_v1.pdf):
- 10:00: warm traffic steering to canary pool (5% traffic)
- 10:15: orchestrator exercise (scale 1->3, validate KV warmup)
- 10:30: connectivity probes (conn track, TLS handshake, healthcheck)
- 11:00: degrade one node to simulate instance eviction, confirm fallback to reserved variant
- 11:30: restore and verify steady state

Can you confirm the bridge (Zoom + PagerDuty on-call) and whether you want us to execute or hand over to your on-site infra lead? Also included an optional checklist (orchestration-checksheet.csv) with the probes we intend to run.

Thanks,
Jae Kim
Infra Support
Acme Cloud Integrations

Attachments: smoke-playbook_v1.pdf, orchestration-checksheet.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Infra Support <infra-support@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Action] orchestration smoke drill window + connectivity acceptance

Thanks Jae — plan looks good. A few notes from our side before we greenlight:

- Please run the orchestrator exercise against the canary model group only (model:v3-canary). Do not touch production pools.
- Add a KV-cache-priming step that posts a 500-token warmup prompt to each canary instance; we want to validate KV persistence after scale.
- For the node eviction test, use the graceful-drain signal (SIGTERM + 45s grace) so we can observe in-flight request behavior.
- We will own the final traffic shift back to 100%; please present your rollback play if things look bad.

I'll attach the latest runbook (runbook_v2.pdf) which updates the validation queries and expected latency thresholds. I'll be on the bridge from 09:45 onwards. CCing Marissa and Connor for telemetry hooks.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Engineering Manager, Deployment
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Mina — quick technical checklist additions from ops: 

- Healthcheck variance: please ensure the health probe tolerance window is set to 12s (we'll be hammering readiness endpoints during scale).
- TLS cert pinning: we will temporarily bypass strict client pinning for the canary hostnames to avoid handshake failures during rotation.
- Observability: add a short-lived span tag "smoke.window=2027-06-30T10:00-12:00" so we can filter traces easily.
- Network probes: run a traceroute and capture first 5 hops pre and post scale (attach as network-tracelog-brief.txt).

I updated the runbook with the above notes and left inline expected thresholds. If Acme runs the eviction test, please call out the exact instance ID you plan to drain.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference

All — I'll join the bridge as infra lead. Quick asks: 

1) Can someone post the Grafana smoke dashboard link in the bridge at start? Use the filter for model:v3-canary and smoke.window tag.
2) Please confirm PagerDuty incident channel: PD-Runbook RB-9821 is set as the escalation.
3) Let's keep the bridge duration to 45 minutes (10:00-10:45) for the active exercise, with an optional 10:45-12:00 observation window. If anything is degraded we will extend.

I'll prepare a short JIRA postmortem template we can fill if we hit any gating failures (will link on the bridge).

-Aditya

Thanks all — confirming Acme will run the orchestrator exercise and traceroutes. A couple of operational callouts before we start: 

- Expect a 10-20s transient increase in tail latency during KV priming; we will abort if error rate exceeds 1%.
- For the eviction simulation we'll pick an instance from bk-nodepool-canary-4 (ID: i-canary-04). We'll publish the ID to the bridge 60s before the drain starts.
- Attached a short trace snippet from our test lab that shows expected packet loss profile during simulated eviction (network-tracelog-brief.txt).

Bridge details: Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: redwood-smoke)
PagerDuty: RB-9821

See you on the bridge — Samuel / Edge Integrate
